_comment: Public captions for the page, written to ASD-STE100. build.py copies each clip from 'src' (relative to the project root) and makes its poster at 'poster_t' seconds.

01_packing_overview.title: Packing cycle in the U cell
01_packing_overview.subtitle: One continuous take, Isaac Sim 6.0.1 through Genie Sim
01_packing_overview.description: The G2 drives into the U cell. It picks a bag from the table with the left arm and places it over the open carton on the conveyor. Then it moves the right arm to a tote in the sort rack.
notes: The drive-in is 2.0 m in 10.3 s. The final position error is 0.57 cm and 0.00°.
The waist turns first: +55° to the table, 0° to the carton, -95° to the rack. Then the arm moves.
The base holds its position on odometry while the arms move. The base drift is 0.43 cm and 0.07°.
The edit removes the planning time. The clip is 67.8 s at 12 frames per second.
This take was recorded before the object pose relay. The bag stays at its start position on camera, and the grasp is symbolic. Refer to the pilot dataset below for a take where the bag moves.

02_packing_head.title: Head camera view
02_packing_head.subtitle: What the robot sees, 640 × 400
02_packing_head.description: This is the head camera of the G2 during the same take. The data recorder and the training use this view.
notes: The camera is on the official G2 head mount.
The arm paths stay a minimum of 0.20 m from the head camera. The arm colliders of the G2 are off in Genie Sim, so the planner does this check.

03_teleop_replay.title: Recorded teleoperation episode
03_teleop_replay.subtitle: Kinematic replay from the HDF5 file
03_teleop_replay.description: An operator moved the arms with the keyboard. The recorder wrote the joint states, the joint commands and the camera frames. This replay draws the robot again from the recorded data.
notes: Left: the robot model, with the recorded joint positions.
Centre: the head camera and the free camera frames from the episode.
Right: the left-arm joints. Grey is measured. Dark blue is the command. The commands and the measured joints agree within 0.0012 rad.
This episode is from the first, simpler scene with crates and totes.
There is no policy in this clip. It shows the recorded motion only.

04_slam_nav.title: Mapping and navigation
04_slam_nav.subtitle: slam_toolbox makes the map, then Nav2 drives
04_slam_nav.description: The mobile G2 drives a scripted loop around the cell. slam_toolbox makes the map from the two chassis lidars. Then Nav2 drives the robot to a goal on the saved map.
notes: Part 1: mapping at 4.5 times real time. Part 2: a Nav2 goal at 2.5 times real time.
Two of two Nav2 goals succeeded. The final errors are 0.10 m and 0.084 m.
The walls on the map are within 0.1 m of the true wall lines: 99% on three walls, 64% on the wall at the map edge.
This run used the first cell layout. The map must be made again for the U cell.
The lidar mounts are estimates. The official G2 model has no lidar positions. The odometry is ground truth.
